algeria.label: Algeria
algeria.brief: Algeria's Mediterranean coast runs more than a thousand kilometres and is dotted with marinas and ports, but its marquee water network is the Bay of Algiers. The capital's bay is ringed by harbours -- the 450-berth Sidi Fredj marina on the peninsula to the west, the El Djamila marina at Ain Benian, the central Port d'Alger, and the Tamentfoust harbour on the eastern shore below Cap Matifou. These sit minutes apart across the water yet are linked today only by a chronically congested coast road, making the bay a natural fast-shuttle spine. Further west, the Gulf of Oran offers a second local cluster, while Bejaia and Mostaganem anchor their own gulfs.
algeria.corridor_shape: Bay of Algiers is the primary short-hop cluster; Gulf of Oran is a secondary local cluster; Bejaia and Mostaganem are stand-alone coastal anchors. No single national corridor.

algiers-algeria.name: Algiers
algiers-algeria.brief: Algiers wraps a wide Mediterranean bay. On its western peninsula sits Sidi Fredj, a 450-berth marina considered one of the finest on the sea's south shore; between it and the city is the El Djamila marina at Ain Benian; the central Port d'Alger fronts downtown; and across the water on the eastern shore, below the Roman ruins near Cap Matifou, lies the Tamentfoust harbour. All four ring the same bay minutes apart by boat but are chained today only by a congested coast road -- the classic case for a fast water shuttle.

oran-algeria.name: Oran
oran-algeria.brief: Oran is Algeria's second city, set on the Gulf of Oran. Its port fronts the city while the Ain El Turck and Kristel resort waterfronts line the gulf to the west, a short coastal hop away past the Mers-el-Kebir headland.

bejaia-algeria.name: Bejaia
bejaia-algeria.brief: Bejaia sits on a scenic gulf backed by the Gouraya mountain, with a working port and marina. It anchors the central Algerian coast as a stand-alone waterfront node.

mostaganem-algeria.name: Mostaganem
mostaganem-algeria.brief: Mostaganem is a western Algerian coastal city with a marina on its own gulf, anchoring the coast between Oran and Chlef.
